description: The trades between the app's users (neblla.db.offer / acceptOffer). "list": the log, newest first, with { user? (their id in the app), status? (pending | done | declined | cancelled | expired | failed | all, the default), limit?, offset? } → { trades, total }; each trade has from, to, give, get (items { table, id } or { product, amount }), status, reason (why it failed or was cancelled), createdAt, expiresAt, closedAt. Changes nothing; neblla_trades cancels a pending offer.
name: neblla_trades_read
title: Trades (read)
